hfgt_toolbox.cli.main module

hfgt_toolbox.cli.main.gis_dir_to_sysml(input_directory, output_filepath, idx_column_name='id', my_class='myClass')

Convert all GIS files (.csv and .shp) in the specified directory into to a single .sysml file.

Each file is represented as a Package within the overarching ‘Model’ Package, with its own parts and part defs. Note that the class name needs to be the same for every file, and the idx_column name must also be the same for every file.

Typer is used to allow this function to be called via command line without needing to deal with *args etc, checking the number of arguments, etc.

Parameters:

  • input_directory (str) – the path of the input data folder.

  • output_filepath (str) – the path of output the data.

  • idx_column_name (Optional, str) – The name of the index column (which uniquely identifies each row).

  • my_class (Optional, str) – This string will become the name of the class associated with GIS Data File.

hfgt_toolbox.cli.main.gis_to_sysml(input_filepath, output_filepath, idx_column_name='id', my_class='myClass')

Convert a file containing GIS data (in either CSV or Shapefile format) into a single .sysml file.

Parameters:

  • input_filepath (str) – the path of the input data file.

  • output_filepath (str) – the path of output the data.

  • idx_column_name (str) – The name of the index column (which uniquely identifies each row).

  • my_class (str) – This string will become the name of the class associated with GIS Data File.
